terminal.emulator: direct PTY with deterministic loopback HTTP/SSE schema recorder

reference.capture: fresh synthetic-home Hermes TUI process with two ordinary prompts and a normalized schema-only request recorder

normalization: The reference checkout, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, prompt and response text, credentials, authorization values, session identifiers, timestamps, and animated redraw bytes are omitted or represented by stable markers.
The provider is a deterministic 127.0.0.1 fixture owned by the probe; no external network, OAuth flow, tool action, user credential, or private runtime state is used.

Tool descriptions are reduced to presence, length, and SHA-256 markers; parameter schemas retain names, types, required names, structural keys, shape markers, and counts without copying description text or arbitrary payload values.
The two ordinary streaming requests are compared for stable schema inventory. The auxiliary non-stream request is recorded separately and is not classified as a retry or promoted into Hades behavior.

steps.precondition: Fresh Hermes TUI at 120x40 with an isolated synthetic HERMES_HOME and a configured custom provider at the probe-owned loopback endpoint.

output.terminal_restoration: bounded Ctrl+C cleanup returned the PTY to the reference clean-exit boundary

unknowns: Tool-call response handling, execution, approval, retries, discovery details, persistence, token accounting, and behavior outside two ordinary completed turns remain unobserved.
Description text is represented by presence, length, and a digest; private or dynamic description payloads are not copied into the fixture.
